formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x2 x3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x4 : Bool),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 →     (∀ (x6 : Fin x1.gates.length), ∀ x7 ∈ (x1.gates.get x6).inputs, x7 < (27 : ℕ) + ↑x6) →       have x7 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))};       have x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → List Bool := fun (x8 x9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => (List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x10 = x8)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x10 = x9);       have x9 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → List Bool := fun (x9 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => (List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x10 ∈ x9)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (∀ x11 ∈ x9, x11 - x10 ∉ x7);       have x10 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Prop := fun (x10 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => x10.card = (4 : ℕ) ∧ ∀ (x11 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x12 ∈ x10 | x12 - x11 ∈ x7}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ);       (∀ (x11 x12 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x11 - x12 ∈ x7 → x11 ≠ x2 ∨ x12 ≠ x3 → x1.eval (x8 x11 x12 ++ [x4]) = Bool.true) → (∀ (x12 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x10 x12 → x1.eval (x9 x12 ++ [x4]) = Bool.false) → (63 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size
plain_statement: Plane of order 3 (13 points, 13 lines). A circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, each reading earlier wires, on the 26 inputs and one extra wire carrying a constant. If it is true at every incident point-line pair except possibly one chosen pair, and false at every quadrangle input, it has at least 63 gates.
title: A step toward: Plane of order 3: every AND/OR list of fan-in at most two accepting every incident point-line input and rejecting every quadrangle input has at l
